The spaceship's journey through the wormhole serves as the transition from the known to the unknown, while the discovery of an advanced, life-filled galaxy acts as the catalyst for the main conflict. This first contact introduces dual potential outcomes—cooperation or conflict—which sets up the primary tension and drives the narrative forward by defining the core dilemma humanity must now face.
